notes.sowing: Sow directly 1 to 4 weeks after your last frost, once the soil is at least {c:16}, {cm:2} to {cm:5} deep. Thin to {cm:30} to {cm:40} apart, wider for giant types. Sow again every 2 weeks for a longer show.
notes.care: Full sun. Stake tall varieties with a strong cane at planting and tie the stem in as it grows; dwarf types need no support and suit large pots. Water deeply as flower buds form. The flowers feed bees and other pollinators.
notes.harvest: Single-stem types flower once, about 9 to 11 weeks from sowing. Cut for the vase as the petals open. For seed, cut heads with some stem once they droop and dry, and cure them in a warm, airy place for several weeks.
